mem.9:
Conversation between Sam and Evan

18 May 2023
- Evan returned from a family hiking trip in the Rockies, praised the views, shared a lake/mountain photo. His old Prius had broken down, was repaired, then sold; he now drove a new Prius.
- Sam loved hiking but hadn’t gone in a long time; recalled a special hike with their dad at age 10 and shared a forest photo of a man and child. Sam was considering painting as a relaxing hobby.
- Evan had painted watercolors for years after a friend introduced him; it helped him de-stress. He shared a cactus/desert painting and encouraged Sam to try hobbies. Sam was excited to explore; also shared a sunset photo with feet on a car dashboard.

24 May 2023
- Evan described a family trip to Jasper the previous weekend: drove Icefields Parkway, saw glaciers and lakes, stayed in a cozy cabin among mountains/forests; called it peaceful. Shared a glacier photo (description incongruously mentioned someone with a book by a lake). Sam had never been and asked if it was relaxing.
- Sam had a tough week after a doctor’s check-up and disappointing weight reading. Evan recommended enjoyable exercise and small food changes. Painting might help stress/creativity but not weight; Sam planned to paint without pressure.

6 June 2023
- Evan said life was a rollercoaster: sudden heart palpitations the prior week scared him and prompted lifestyle reflection; shared a photo of someone holding medicine.
- Sam was trying to eat healthier (shared vegetables/milk). Evan was eating less processed food and fewer sugary snacks but loved ginger snaps; Sam still enjoyed soda and candy. Evan suggested flavored seltzer and high-cocoa dark chocolate; Sam agreed to try and offered mutual support.
- Evan offered to meet and teach basic exercises, saying workouts clear the mind (shared bearded man with dumbbell); Sam was keen. Sam complained supermarket self-checkouts were all broken; Evan sympathized.

27 July 2023
- Sam said friends mocked their weight the prior Friday; it hurt and motivated change. Evan offered to work on health together, said progress takes time, and shared he’d struggled with health a few years earlier.
- Evan recommended less sugar and more produce (shared produce photo). Sam was cutting soda/candy but struggling. Evan suggested seltzer, air-popped popcorn, fruit. Sam liked seltzer, asked for snack ideas and the title of his gripping mystery novel; Evan answered “The Great Gatsby” (shared fruit bowls and alcohol photo).
- Evan encouraged small steps/progress over perfection (book beside green apple photo) and exercise (woman backpacking on mountain photo). Sam planned regular gym visits starting the next day.

7 August 2023
- Evan said he’d gone to Canada the prior week and met an “awesome Canadian woman”; being with her made him feel alive. Shared couple walking hand-in-hand in snow. Sam congratulated him and worried health issues might limit enjoyment (shared beach walker/surfboard photo). Evan called it a nice change after health issues: “you never know what life’s gonna throw at you.”
- Evan shared ginger-snap cookie photo (his weakness) and woman/child on a swing, which Sam thought might be his kids. His two-year health journey had ups and downs; family motivated him.
- Fitness watch/tracking and visual reminders motivated him (watch box and wrist photos). Adventure/hikes (small island and lone boat photo) and caring for a resilient bonsai (black vase on wooden table) inspired him. Sam agreed small consistent actions build resilience. Sam’s goodbye oddly addressed Sam; Evan said “Catch ya later!”

13 August 2023 (session began 4:09 pm)
- Evan returned from a “rad vacay” in Canada with new significant other; they hiked, biked, explored (tent in grassy field photo).
- Sam said things had been challenging and affecting health; Evan sympathized. Sam said his support helped them stay positive (shared note with progress-over-perfection message). Sam’s quote: “Don't fear it, just take the first step. It's been helping me move forward to healthier habits!” They discussed celebrating small wins.
- Evan had spent half an hour searching for keys, which he loses weekly. Sam described a dream of soaring over skyscrapers and asked its meaning; Evan suggested a dream-interpretation book. Sam said health efforts felt endless but worthwhile. Evan told Sam to go to bed and take care.

15 August 2023, 4:20 pm
- Evan’s son injured his ankle in a soccer accident Saturday 12 August. Evan cared for him and took him to the doctor; it was hard seeing him hurt. Shared foot-cast photo. Ankle was improving but sore, not serious.
- Sam had a tough week and doctor’s appointment, a wake-up call to care for themselves; took a cooking class for healthier meals. Sam said class was great and they’d made flavorful grilled salmon and vegetables the previous night (shared plate photo), offering recipes. Evan wanted more vegetables; Sam offered easy roasted vegetables.
- Sam felt worried about health but motivated, taking one step at a time. Evan encouraged small steps; Sam appreciated his support and promised to continue.

19 August 2023, 6:17 pm
- Sam announced starting a diet and healthier lifestyle, tough but determined; shared spinach, avocado, strawberry bowl. Reported more energy and less sluggishness after meals.
- Sam shared grilled chicken/vegetable stir-fry (two bowls, chopsticks, sauce photo), offered homemade sauce recipe; Evan wanted to try it. Sam shared recipe-card photo, described as a vase-of-flowers drawing.
- Evan had started painting classes a few days earlier, enjoying them and seeking like-minded people/showing his work. Years earlier a friend gave him a painting that inspired him to start. Class taught watercolor and observing/painting nature; painting brought peace, self-expression, stress relief. Shared photos of forest painting on easel, painting tools, watercolors, sunset over ocean, and pink-flowered tree in field.
- Evan loved landscapes and capturing nature’s peaceful “vibe.” Flowering tree reminded him of road trips in his trusty car; shared truck parked in forest. He said the previous month he drove somewhere fun with amazing views (shared skier on snowy trail). Sam asked if Banff; Evan confirmed skiing there was great, snow amazing, hoped to return next year (shared group skiing photo).
- Sam wanted to try skiing but worried their body couldn’t handle it. Evan enjoyed skiing, snowboarding, ice skating and hoped Sam might join someday. Sam said maybe, though it was hard, and thanked him for understanding.

27 August 2023, 10:18 am
- Sam said they started a new diet and exercise routine the previous Monday, felt great, and asked Evan about his recent changes. Evan had twisted his knee the previous Friday; it was very painful and disrupted his usual fitness routine, frustrating because activity mattered greatly to him.
- Sam sympathized and offered help. Evan said life throws curveballs and mentioned a book he’d discussed, saying every page made it better and he couldn’t put it down. Sam encouraged adaptability, low-impact exercise or PT, and said Evan had made them interested in the book. Evan hoped to get a PT appointment; meanwhile he was taking it easy and swimming. Sam praised swimming as low-impact and refreshing.
- Evan shared a photo of a car parked by a lake with mountains, from a road trip the previous month. He said he went to the Rocky Mountains; scenery was stunning and relaxing. Sam loved nature, hadn’t road-tripped in ages, and hoped healthier habits would make hiking possible.
- Evan suggested more hikes and proposed they hike together sometime (shared lake/mountain photo). Sam asked for a local lake/trail recommendation. Evan shared another lake/mountain photo, said it was gorgeous with nearby trails; only a two-hour drive and worth it for views and peaceful atmosphere. Sam said a day trip was doable and planned to check it out. They said goodbye.
